pages.text: The Pancheon separates milk into skim milk and cream. Add milk with a bucket or iron milking bucket, then let the pancheon settle while it processes.
The pancheon has one input tank and two output tanks. Use the GUI to watch the input, skim milk, cream, and bubbly progress.
Output buckets drain from the finished tanks first. If the pancheon is not processing, an empty bucket can also remove milk from the input tank.
